name: iikiti
description: Cross-browser RSS feed reader web extension.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/extract-inline.js && bun run build:cldr && bun run build:scripts
scripts.build:scripts: mkdir -p build/cldr && cp .resources/cldr/languages.json build/cldr/languages.json && esbuild src/background/index.ts --bundle --outfile=build/background.js --format=esm && esbuild src/content/index.ts --bundle --outfile=build/content.js --format=esm
